record.body:
## Outcome

The web dashboard home screen shows only what the user needs: phases grouped by milestone, a calm side rail without a journal dump, then deeper navigation, phase structure UI, and a task graph in later phases of this milestone.

## Exit criteria

All five planned phases under this milestone are done: milestone-nav, side-rail-calm, deep-links, phase-overview, and task-graph. A human can open the web dashboard on this repo and scan an effort by milestone without reading the full journal on the home screen.
record.subject: web-calm
